Game Overview

In Coe Rabbit, the core idea is straightforward: guide an adorable bunny through tricky puzzles and teleport across platforms to collect power-ups. Master the perfect route to success, pilot a carrot ship, and dodge obstacles. Challenge your friend in thrilling two-player mode and see who emerges victorious in this captivating adventure!

How to Play

Getting started in Coe Rabbit doesn't take long to learn. Guide an adorable bunny through tricky puzzles and teleport across platforms to collect power-ups. Master the perfect route to success, pilot a carrot ship, and dodge obstacles. Challenge your friend in thrilling two-player mode and see who emerges victorious in this captivating adventure!
